source.author: stat
source.text: sic orsus aperto flagrantes immisit equos, non ocius alti in terras cadit ira Iovis, si quando nivalem Othryn et Arctoae gelidum caput institit Ossae armavitque in nube manum: volat ignea moles saeva dei mandata ferens, caelumque trisulca territat omne coma iamdudum aut ditibus agris signa dare aut ponto miseros involvere nautas.
source.text_original: ' sic orsus aperto / flagrantes immisit equos, non ocius alti / in terras cadit ira Iovis, si quando nivalem / Othryn et Arctoae gelidum caput institit Ossae / armavitque in nube manum: volat ignea moles / saeva dei mandata ferens, caelumque trisulca / territat omne coma iamdudum aut ditibus agris / signa dare aut ponto miseros involvere nautas.
source.text_english: Thus having begun, he let loose his flaming horses at the open. Not more swiftly does the wrath of high Jupiter fall upon the earth, when ever he has climbed snowy Othrys and the icy summit of Arctoan Ossa and has armed his hand in the cloud: the fiery mass flies, bearing the savage god’s commands, and long since with its three-forked mane it terrifies all heaven, either to give signs to the rich fields or to overwhelm wretched sailors in the sea.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: dixit et ingenti flammantem nubila sulco direxit per inane facem, quae puppe propinqua in bifidum discessit iter fratresque petivit Tyndareos, placida et mediis in frontibus haesit protinus amborum lumenque innoxia fundit purpureum, miseris olim implorabile nautis.
reuse.text_original: ' / dixit et ingenti flammantem nubila sulco / direxit per inane facem, quae puppe propinqua / in bifidum discessit iter fratresque petivit / Tyndareos, placida et mediis in frontibus haesit / protinus amborum lumenque innoxia fundit / purpureum, miseris olim implorabile nautis.
reuse.text_english: He spoke, and with a mighty furrow he sent through the void a blazing torch that, as it drew near the ship, parted into a twofold course and sought the sons of Tyndareus; peaceful, it at once clung to the middle of both their brows and pours forth a harmless purple light, once a thing to be implored by wretched sailors.
